name: The Invisible fan
source:
It is your first day as a singer's temporary assistant, as your cousin asked you to cover for her for a few days.  You have no idea who she is, but the pay is excellent and that is all you care about. 

However, on your first day, you will meet a very peculiar fan. There is something about him that catches your attention;  he is definitely not an ordinary person.

[From [url=https://karisbunny.itch.io/the-invisible-fan]itch.io[/url]]
